results.note: The same subscription callback saw the whole sequence. The browser never reloaded and the graph never went empty: it went stale.

results.title: our instance is recycled mid-stream
transcript: established sockets to threews-ha-4 before: 0
while the child streamed: 2
child exited 0 and reported: CLOSED 1
established sockets after: 0
a fresh instance re-subscribed in 25.3ms
results.note: SIGTERM runs the runtime shutdown hook, which closes every held socket. The house sees a clean disconnect rather than a dead connection it has to time out, and the next instance is streaming again in well under a second.

results.note: Reads degrade to the graph this process already holds, a write is still attempted because a write is somebody pressing a button, and only the audit row waits. A cold acquire fails with a designed error rather than hanging, and the flag clears itself on the first query that answers.

results.title: a slow house, beside a fast one
transcript: a 2000ms delay on every response from threews-ha-7, injected at the socket
fast house alone: p50 1.61ms, p95 7.5ms over 2130 calls in 6000ms
slow house at the default 15s connect timeout: connected after 14086ms
slow house connected in 14034ms with a 120s timeout
slow house under 6-deep load: p50 2013.52ms, p95 2020.45ms over 30 calls
fast house beside it: p50 1.58ms, p95 7.99ms over 2213 calls in 6000ms, spanning 3.0 of the neighbour's round trips
fast house alone again, straight after: p50 1.61ms, p95 7.65ms over 2133 calls in 6000ms
results.note: Each home has its own socket; the process and its event loop are the only things they share. The gate is that the fast house never INHERITS the neighbour's latency: with the neighbour at 2,000ms it must stay under 2.5% of that. The finer drift is reported beside the spread between two bracketing alone-readings, because a difference smaller than the movement between two identical controls is a reading of a shared machine, not of the slow house. The default 15s connect timeout is what bounds a house this slow in production, and the long timeout here exists only so isolation could be measured with the slow house actually connected.

results.note: The frame budget measured here is the data half: how long it takes to rebuild the room graph the 3D scene renders. Coalescing is what keeps that off the critical path, and the ratio above is it working.
